title: AI and agent access, evidence gate and change log
summary: Added Markdown twins of every page, llms.txt and llms-full.txt, a page and files for AI systems, evidence packs, open data descriptions (OpenAPI and CSV), discovery files and a citation page. Claims now reach pages only after an automated check finds every term they rest on in a cited source; each claim carries one of three evidence labels.
